mapper.update: UPDATE llm_connectivity_checks SET status='RUNNING',current_stage=#{stage},stage_results=CAST(#{stageResults} AS jsonb),started_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND status='QUEUED'
UPDATE llm_connectivity_checks SET current_stage=#{stage},stage_results=CAST(#{stageResults} AS jsonb) WHERE id=#{id} AND status='RUNNING'

UPDATE llm_connectivity_checks SET status=#{status},availability=#{availability},current_stage=#{stage}, stage_results=CAST(#{stageResults} AS jsonb),error_code=#{errorCode},error_summary=#{errorSummary}, total_duration_ms=#{totalDurationMs},connect_duration_ms=#{connectDurationMs}, first_token_duration_ms=#{firstTokenDurationMs},finished_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND status IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING')

UPDATE llm_connectivity_checks SET status='CANCELED',availability='UNTESTED',current_stage='CANCELED', stage_results=CAST(#{stageResults} AS jsonb),error_code='LLM_CHECK_CANCELED', error_summary='连接检测已取消',finished_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND status IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING')

UPDATE llm_connectivity_checks SET status='FAILED',availability='UNAVAILABLE',current_stage='INTERRUPTED', error_code='DEPENDENCY_INTERRUPTED',error_summary='服务重启导致连接检测中断', finished_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE status IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING')
mapper.select: SELECT id,actor_id,config_id,fingerprint,endpoint_host,model,status,availability,current_stage, stage_results::text stage_results,error_code,error_summary,total_duration_ms, connect_duration_ms,first_token_duration_ms,request_id,started_at,finished_at,created_at FROM llm_connectivity_checks WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE llm_provider_runtime_states SET availability=#{availability},latest_check_id=#{checkId}, last_success_at=CASE WHEN #{availability}='AVAILABLE' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE last_success_at END, last_failure_at=CASE WHEN #{availability} IN ('DEGRADED','UNAVAILABLE') THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE last_failure_at END, consecutive_failures=CASE WHEN #{availability}='AVAILABLE' THEN 0 ELSE consecutive_failures+1 END, breaker_state=CASE WHEN #{availability}='AVAILABLE' THEN 'CLOSED' ELSE breaker_state END, breaker_opened_at=CASE WHEN #{availability}='AVAILABLE' THEN NULL ELSE breaker_opened_at END, last_error_code=#{errorCode},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE config_id=#{configId}

UPDATE llm_provider_runtime_states SET consecutive_failures=0,last_success_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,last_error_code=NULL,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE config_id=#{configId} AND breaker_state='CLOSED'

UPDATE llm_provider_runtime_states SET consecutive_failures=consecutive_failures+1,last_failure_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,last_error_code=#{errorCode}, availability=CASE WHEN consecutive_failures+1>=#{threshold} THEN 'UNAVAILABLE' ELSE availability END, breaker_state=CASE WHEN consecutive_failures+1>=#{threshold} THEN 'OPEN' ELSE breaker_state END, breaker_opened_at=CASE WHEN consecutive_failures+1>=#{threshold} THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE breaker_opened_at END, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE config_id=#{configId}
